item.title: Coffee plants need consistent moisture. Water them regularly, keeping the soil evenly moist but not waterlogged
item.description: Maintaining consistent moisture for coffee plants is essential for their health and successful growth. Coffee plants prefer to have a consistently moist but well-draining soil.
